message:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "xmlDefaultSAXHandler" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/SAX.c | head -10</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
